author: AFLTackler
body:
Hi all,

 I have started making a map and i am looking for feedback and criticism for this map so far. I also need ideas for structures for both the monuments and the blank spaces on this map {This includes the 4 boxes in the middle and the end boxes on the team sides}. If there is any reason as to why I can't submit this map i would like to be notified as I am a first time map builder and do not know all the rules and regulations yet.

EDIT: I now need a new name for this map any suggestions are appreciated.

Thanks in advanc

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
What to add:
- Add more islands to provide better game-play rather then everyone been cluttered in a small space.

- Add more structures. The map seems to be flat and could use more buildings/structures to help stabilize game-play reasons. It also helps to not be sniped every 1 second xP

- The map lacks variation is blocks and very few detail used. Try to improvise and try to use more blocks! Also try adding more detail to boost the aesthetics factor.

Good luck, and keep up the awesome work! :D

replies.author: BourbonBonobo
replies.body: -1. The land is a bit flat for me, the monuments are pretty close to spawn, but I like the colors of the map. Btw, I thought of a cool name for the map, I think the theme could be like a western map, named after some sort of western theme. I think you should name it after some sort of indian tribe, but incorporate some western battle theme/place such as a fortress. I thought maybe the name Fort Mojave sounded pretty good. Or maybe Make a name that includes an animal in the desert. I thought the following best support desert wildlife: Coyotes, Cacti, Rattle snakes, Copperhead snakes, Toads (yes there are desert toads). Anyways, I hope this info can help improve your map and may be help name it as well! -CP
